scientific_integrity: The theorem has a self-contained analytic proof and a standard-library exact-rational checker; finite computations corroborate only finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Finite strictly positive ordered alphabet; pairwise sign criterion is sufficient and not necessary; no higher-order negative association or infinite-support extension is claimed. 1996 geometric-word article and older monographs not inspected in full.
title: Sign reversal and reverse-hazard negativity for discrete record events
